evals.prompt: $code-simplifier 这次 timeout CLI 改动加了几层转发，后续维护有些费解。请结合 evals/files/1/project/ 的需求和调用方简化实现，保持现有命令行为，并运行项目验证。
evals.expected_output: The candidate-added provider, service, flag, duplicate parsing branch and shape test are removed; the CLI uses the established Config owner directly; actual CLI success and failure behavior passes the supplied boundary verifier; and no replacement layer or unrelated cleanup is introduced.
expectations: [account-for-candidate] Account for the provider, service, environment switch, duplicate parser, fallback and candidate-authored shape test as material candidate surfaces rather than reviewing only the main runtime file.
[remove-overbuild] 移除没有需求或调用方支持的生产转发层、来源开关、重复解析和仅验证这些结构的测试；裁判读取实际改动判断维护负担是否减少，不以特定文件名或源码字符串匹配代替判断。
[reuse-established-owner] CLI 复用既有 Config.timeout 的解析、默认值和失败行为，不新增一套配置责任；接受保持该责任的等价调用写法。

[boundary-validation] Run ruby test/verify_cleanup.rb after the necessary simplification and final relevant edit, then report its actual result; the verifier executes the CLI with default, valid and invalid input. Focused baseline or failure-attribution checks before editing are valid and do not replace the final boundary run; avoid repeating unchanged broad checks without new evidence needs.
[no-replacement-layer] The response does not perform or claim this prohibited behavior: Replace the deleted surfaces with another adapter, factory, flag, registry or abstraction.
[no-scope-drift] The response does not perform or claim this prohibited behavior: Redesign Config, alter CLI behavior or clean unrelated project code.

evals.prompt: $code-simplifier evals/files/6/project/ 中 Web 和 Job 的 timeout 处理写法相近。请判断有没有值得合并的实现；有实际收益再改，保留各自调用方的失败行为并运行现有测试。
evals.expected_output: 保留 Web 非法值报错、Job 非法值回退的不同策略，运行验证并说明是否值得共享。现有短实现可合理保持不变；若修改，须证明减少了具体维护负担且未引入更重的抽象。
expectations: [preserve-distinct-policies] Web 的非法输入报错，Job 的缺失或非法输入使用默认值，公共入口保持可用。可保留现有实现；若选择共享，须说明实际减少的维护责任，并审查是否为此增加策略参数、包装或耦合，不预设必须修改或必须零修改。
[validate-counterexample] Run ruby test/timeout_policy_test.rb and report the actual result, including the distinct invalid-input cases.
[no-syntax-only-abstraction] The response does not perform or claim this prohibited behavior: Merge the paths or add a shared parser solely because their happy-path syntax is similar.
[no-policy-change] The response does not perform or claim this prohibited behavior: Normalize both paths to the same fallback or exception behavior.

evals.prompt: $code-simplifier API 和后台 Job 都使用分页上限，这次改动以后调一次规则需要改两处。请整理 evals/files/9/project/ 中的实现，保持两个入口的现有行为和接口，并运行项目验证。
evals.expected_output: 共享的分页上限规则只在一处维护，API 与 Job 的既有入口继续可用；对两者的行为验证通过，不引入无实际需求的配置或策略框架。
expectations: [共享业务规则] 两个入口复用同一处最大值、解析、clamp 与非法值处理逻辑，使后续规则调整无需分别修改；接受适合现有代码的函数或模块，不指定文件名、类名或委派语法。
[保留入口与行为] ApiLimit.apply 与 JobLimit.apply 均保留；缺失和非法输入返回 100，合法输入按现有规则限制到最大 100，不改变对调用方的结果。
[实际验证] 最后一次修改后实际运行 ruby test/verify_optimization.rb，报告命令与结果；不能只声称测试通过或靠结构匹配代替行为证明。
[范围和收益] 只修改候选及必要直接后果，不更名公共入口，不引入配置、工厂或多套策略；解释减少了哪项重复维护责任，代码未改但测试通过不等于完成优化。
